name: Lambda Invoke
description: Invoke an AWS Lambda function as a Dagster asset -- synchronous (parses the JSON response) or async fire-and-forget, fails loudly on a Lambda-side FunctionError unless told not to.
author: Dagster Community

outputs.description: MaterializeResult with the parsed Lambda response in metadata

function_name.description: Lambda function name, partial ARN, or full ARN.
function_name.label: Function Name

aws_profile.label: Aws Profile
aws_profile.description: Named AWS profile. Omit to use the default boto3 credential chain (env vars, instance role, etc.).

payload.label: Payload
payload.description: Static JSON payload sent as the Lambda event. Mutually exclusive with payload_template.

payload_template.label: Payload Template
payload_template.description: Jinja2 template rendered to a JSON string and sent as the Lambda event -- use for a payload that needs `{{ partition_key }}`/`{{ env.* }}`/etc. Mutually exclusive with payload.

qualifier.label: Qualifier
qualifier.description: Function version or alias to invoke, e.g. 'PROD' or '3'. Omit for $LATEST.

fail_on_function_error.label: Fail On Function Error
fail_on_function_error.description: Raise if the Lambda's own invocation errored (FunctionError in the response). False materializes anyway with the error payload in metadata.

include_logs.label: Include Logs
include_logs.description: Request the last 4KB of CloudWatch logs (LogType=Tail) and surface them as metadata. Adds response overhead -- leave off unless debugging.

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start Date

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme_corp,globex,initech'. Required for static and multi types.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.
partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only.

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'.

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset. 'single_run' fires ONE external call covering the whole backfill range -- the partition_key/partition_start/partition_end tokens this component already supports are comma-joined/range-spanning rather than a single key -- instead of one call per partition. 'multi_run' launches one run per partition. Leave empty for Dagster's default (one run per partition, uncapped). Ignored when Partition Type is not set.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For Backfill Policy = 'multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run. Leave empty for Dagster's default (1).

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
